summary: MoneyHero Limited, a Nasdaq-listed Greater Southeast Asia personal finance aggregation and digital insurance brokerage platform, furnished a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026 attaching a press release reporting unaudited second quarter 2026 results. Total transaction value was flat year-over-year at US$20.9 million in Q2 and grew 9% to US$41.5 million in the first half. Revenue was US$15.8 million in Q2, down 13% year-over-year, and US$32.3 million for the first half. Net loss was US$(1.2) million, driven by foreign exchange volatility. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
